gaps: External provider mutations are limited to six connected estimate/bill/draft action names; no other provider write action is registered or oracle-covered.

Local durable-state mutations through goals/goal_runs/canvas have at most the existing task/workflow verifiers; canvas update, present, restore and goal-run state changes are not independently postcondition-verified.
HTTP mutation routes are overwhelmingly outside the registered action registry; their correctness is covered, if at all, by route/service tests rather than the oracle.
Provider adapters expose many write methods; only a small subset is reachable through registered, verified actions.
next_verifiers: canvas.update / canvas.restore_version: compare persisted content revision/hash against the authorized mutation and reject stale or different-object writes.
canvas.present_markdown / canvas.present_chart: verify the audit record and returned canvas identity, not only the broadcast.
goals.create / goal_runs.start: verify the persisted goal/run identity and state before dependent work continues.
goals.decompose / goals.evaluate: verify the persisted plan or evaluation revision and its source/goal binding.
Provider send/connect/disconnect/refresh routes: require explicit operation identity and authoritative readback before claiming success.
